fix_subject: fix #19984 so we shouldn't use outer table distinct info
pr_title: This pr try to fix #19984 that introduced in eliminate join optimizer,

labels.summary: Join elimination propagated distinct-group information from the wrong (outer) child regardless of which side was eliminated, so the surviving plan could carry distinct information that did not apply to it; the fix uses the inner side's distinct groups.
